title: Sunrise Flow
description: Start your day with mindful movement, mobility, and breathwork.
longDescription: A gentle, guided flow designed to greet the day with intention. We move slowly through mobility work, sun salutations, and closing breathwork as the light comes up over the studio garden. No experience necessary — just an open mind and bare feet.
experience: Closing breathwork by the studio garden
A quiet moment of stillness to set your intention
whoCanJoin: Open to all levels, including first-time visitors.

faqs.question: Do I need yoga experience?
faqs.answer: No — the pace is gentle and every pose is offered with a simpler option.

faqs.question: Is there parking on site?
faqs.answer: Yes, free parking is available directly behind the studio.

title: Mindful Strength Workshop
description: Learn how strength training can become more intentional, balanced, and sustainable.
longDescription: A hands-on workshop for anyone who wants to lift with more awareness. We slow the reps down, talk through breath and bracing, and build a simple framework you can carry into your own training — so strength work supports your body instead of wearing it down.
experience: Coaching on breath, bracing, and tempo
A simple strength framework to take home
bring: A notebook if you like to take notes
whoCanJoin: Best suited to those with some prior training experience.

faqs.question: Is equipment provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, all equipment is provided — just bring yourself.

faqs.question: What if I have an old injury?
faqs.answer: Let your coach know beforehand and every movement will be offered with a modification.

title: SoulAura Community Run
description: A relaxed community run designed around movement, connection, and good energy.
longDescription: No pace pressure, no leaderboard — just a shared loop through the park with people who show up for the same reasons you do. We finish together with stretching and fresh fruit at the pavilion.
experience: A 5K loop at a conversational pace
whoCanJoin: Open to all paces, including walkers.

faqs.question: Is this timed or competitive?
faqs.answer: No — there is no clock and no ranking. It is about moving together.

title: Breathwork Reset
description: A guided session to slow down, regulate your nervous system, and clear mental noise.
longDescription: An evening of guided breathwork and stillness. We move through several breathing patterns designed to shift you out of a busy day and into a calmer state, closing with ten minutes of silent meditation.
bring: A blanket or cushion if you have one
whoCanJoin: Open to everyone; not recommended during pregnancy without prior guidance from your doctor.

faqs.question: I have never done breathwork before — is that okay?
faqs.answer: Yes, this session is written for first-timers as much as regulars.

title: Mobility Lab
description: A slow, focused session on the joints and patterns that get the least attention.
longDescription: Hips, ankles, thoracic spine — the areas that quietly limit everything else. This lab walks through targeted mobility drills you can fold into your own warm-up routine.
experience: A short routine to repeat at home
bring: Comfortable clothing you can move in

title: Autumn Wellness Retreat
description: A full weekend away to reset your body, mind, and habits together.
longDescription: Two days at a lakeside retreat combining movement, mindfulness, and rest. Mornings begin with slow flow, afternoons are open for hiking or quiet time, and evenings close with guided reflection by the fire.
whoCanJoin: Open to all levels; limited to 30 guests.

faqs.question: Is transportation provided?
faqs.answer: A shared shuttle departs from the studio Saturday morning and returns Sunday evening.

title: Summer Solstice Gathering
description: An evening of movement, music, and connection to mark the longest day of the year.
longDescription: A community gathering held in the studio garden to welcome summer.

title: Spring Mobility Challenge
description: A 14-day guided challenge to rebuild range of motion after winter.
longDescription: A two-week challenge with a daily mobility drill sent each morning.
